catalogue.note: Pinned geo catalogue archive built in this repository by geo/catalogue-build.mjs from geo/catalogue-src/releases/<version>.json (docs/adr/2026-10-22-gaid-builds-catalogue.md; contract skill_hub docs/specs/gaid-interfaces.md). The backend stages it from GAID_CATALOGUE_ARCHIVE, <GAID_HOME>/catalogue/, geo/catalogue/ next to the checkout, or the named asset (configs/inputs.toml), and verifies the sha256 and every package digest. When none of these has it, the launcher (geo/start.mjs) downloads download.url (GAID_CATALOGUE_URL overrides it; GAID_CATALOGUE_DOWNLOAD=0 turns it off) into <GAID_HOME>/catalogue/ and keeps it only if the sha256 matches. Without the archive no catalogue skills are installed (no fallback to the upstream sources) and GET /geo/catalogue reports where the archive was looked for.

excludedSources.reason: License terms of the four document skills restrict use outside Anthropic's services and redistribution (skill_hub geo-byok-plan section 2.6; release 0.1.0 excludedSources). Not bundled and not fetched automatically; manual installation by the user stays available.
